sn12.40:1.2: yañca bhikkhave ceteti yañca pakappeti yañca anuseti ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā

sn12.40:2.1: no ca bhikkhave ceteti no ca pakappeti atha ca anuseti ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā
sn12.40:2.3: tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nati hoti
sn12.40:2.6: cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā sambhavanti
sn12.40:3.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave no ca ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti ārammaṇametaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā abhisamayaṃyuttassa kaḷārakhattiyavagage dukkhakkhandhanirodho
sn12.40:3.2: ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti
sn12.40:3.3: tadappatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe nati na hoti
sn12.40:3.6: cutūpapāte asati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā nirujjhanti
